description: This Java source file contains a test class 'SnapshotTest' that verifies device snapshot and restore functionalities, including powerwash and reboot scenarios, using the Trade Federation testing framework.

classes.name: SnapshotTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that performs snapshot, restore, reboot, and powerwash tests on an Android device using the Trade Federation framework.

methods.name: testSnapshot
methods.description: Tests the snapshot and restore functionality, verifying persistence of files across reboots and multiple restore attempts.

methods.name: testSnapshotReboot
methods.description: Verifies that a device can be restored from a snapshot and then rebooted successfully.

methods.name: testSnapshotPowerwash
methods.description: Tests restoring a snapshot followed by a powerwash (factory reset) and verifies device reinitialization.

methods.name: testPowerwashSnapshot
methods.description: Performs a powerwash, then snapshots and restores the device, verifying it returns to a clean state.
